title: Dolly Parton Laid to Rest in Intimate Nashville Ceremony
seoTitle: Dolly Parton Laid to Rest in Nashville Ceremony
subtitle: The music legend who defined generations bids her final farewell alongside Carl Thomas
excerpt: Country music queen Dolly Parton has been laid to rest in Nashville in an intimate ceremony alongside her husband of 60 years, Carl Thomas.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Singer Dolly Parton has been laid to rest in a private ceremony in Nashville, family members have confirmed.

Parton, who passed away at the age of 80 following a brief battle with cancer, was entombed at the Woodlawn Memorial Park and Mausoleum.

Her final resting place is alongside her husband, Carl Thomas, with whom she shared 60 years of marriage.

With information from The Guardian.
